title: Agentic AI运行时治理：基于动作边界控制与可信溯源的安全执行
summary: 介绍Aegis运行时治理系统，将模型输出视为动作提案，通过可信决策层在工具执行前进行中介。系统基于策略状态评估、服务端溯源解析、不确定时失败关闭，并采用基于仲裁的非单边授权路径。在6300行沙箱语料上，Aegis治理下零风险副作用，验证了运行时动作边界治理的有效性。
summary_en: Introduces Aegis, a runtime governance system treating model outputs as action proposals mediated by a trusted decision layer before tool execution. It evaluates against policy, resolves provenance server-side, fails closed under uncertainty, and uses Senate-style quorum settlement. In 6300-row sandbox corpus, zero risky side-effects under governance.
